sources: Mountain Bearer (6-star polearm), skill 3 sk_wpn_lance_0012 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData, game 1.6; values SkillPatchTable L1–L9: dmg_up 0.2–0.56, all_attr_up / all_attr_up2 0.08–0.224, duration 15 s; cd 0.1 s from the SkillData blackboard). Its `buffs` give the wielder buff_wpn_lance_0012_noguard for the whole fight (lifeType 1): damageModifier with CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced buff_physical_no_guard ≥ 1 on the target (Vulnerable), DamageScaleProcessor NormalCalcZone +dmg_up. passiveEventActions abilityEvent 206 (a buff the wielder outputs) with CheckOriginSkillType [2] (from a battle skill): tag 1075718177 (Vulnerable) → buff_wpn_lance_0012_attribute, tag 1066759270 (Physical Susceptibility) → _attribute2 (attributes 39–42 formulaItem 6: All Attributes +all_attr_up / +all_attr_up2, duration; stackingType 4, refreshed), each behind its own 0.1 s timed marker. Batch-4 reports docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0033_camille.md rows 36–40 (draft) and chr_0015_lifeng.md § Kit (moved to Lifeng at the merge).
Skills 1–2 (Agility, Physical DMG) are stat-panel lines. toggleBuffs buff_wpn_lance_0003 with atk_up from this skill's blackboard, which has none (0): inert.

The All Attributes percentages raise the four attributes (the panel's percent slot) and through them ATK's attribute bonus, as the stat panel computes it (effects.ts zone `attribute`; on Lifeng about +17% ATK each), besides `attr` reads. The DMG bonus's condition is judged after the hit's own applications (batch-3 C1), as the data checks the target at the DamageAction: a hit that adds the first Vulnerable stack gets it. Not in any log.
